title: scene_semantics.json: the output of DexAgent Stage 1

task_summary.description: One sentence: which hand does what to which object, in order.

video.description: Clip facts read with probe_video: path, duration_s, fps, frames.

support_surface.description: What everything rests on. Never an object.

camera.description: Where the camera is and whether it moves.

name.description: Short visual noun phrase a detector can find: colour + noun.

parts.description: Named parts when more than one matters (articulated objects always).

pieces.description: Only for a group object: several separate, identical or similar pieces that the task treats as one thing (a tower of loose blocks, a pile, fan or pyramid of cards, a group of bricks taken one at a time). type, properties and size then describe one piece.

count.description: How many pieces the group has at the first frame.

at_least.description: true when only a lower bound can be counted (count is then the minimum). Default false.

kind.description: Singular noun for one piece: block, bar, card, brick, bead.

loose.description: true (default): the pieces are separate bodies held together only by gravity and friction, so one can be taken, slid or knocked off; false: they never separate in the task and may be rebuilt as one body.

appearance.description: Colour, material, markings, per part when useful.

approximate_size.description: Qualitative or rough, read from the video: 'palm-sized', 'about as tall as the mug'.

properties.description: What the reconstruction must reproduce for the task to be possible, in natural language: mechanism, constraints, contact behaviour, what stays fixed.

evidence.description: Prompt words and the times or frames that confirm the object and its type.

object_refs.description: Object ids involved; a part may follow a colon: drawer_unit:sliding_tray.

goal.description: An observable success condition for this subgoal.

observed_outcome.description: Only when what the video shows differs from the intended goal or cannot be resolved.

task_success.description: Every required final physical relation in words, using separate clauses and explicit object or part names; qualitative only.
